# Marker export regression subset

These exact single-frame timing rows and two selected regime metric columns
come from the repository's `timing-direct` workload at 0.4.9 on matching Nsight
2026.3.1.0/build 38722833. Duplicate sibling paths and original numeric text are
preserved. `provenance.json` records original/subset hashes and the pinned source
qualification. The labels contain no host identity or private application data.

The subset checks unique exact path association and explicit ambiguity refusal.
It does not prove generic draw membership, physical counter scaling or hardware
compatibility. The private API/timestamp witness remains separate from product
results.
